latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.17
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.17

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.17. The engines are 0.1.63 on every platform, and so is Control, the small program that installs and updates them. The update feed is sequence 129.

## What changes for you

- Update as usual (see Updating below). Your models, chats and settings stay.
- The engines are new downloads: `strata update` and the app fetch them. Every platform has one (Windows, Linux, Mac, DGX Spark).
- **The route tail skip is off by default.** It was on by default on NVIDIA and on Radeon RX 9000 cards, and answers differed slightly from a run without it. If you want it, turn it on (below).
- **Setup leaves 17 GB of RAM free, not 24, on a PC where the model does not fit in RAM.** A 64 GB PC now holds 47 GiB of experts in RAM (it was 40). Details below.
- The Coder model has a new pinned build (#3445).
- On a PC with one NVIDIA card of 16 GB or less from the RTX 50 series, one more speed setting is on by default (below). It can be turned off.
- New settings are off by default, unless the line for that setting says otherwise.

## The route tail skip is off by default

- **What it is:** "Skip rarely used parts of the model" in Expert settings (`STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP`). When a verify window needs an expert that every token routes at rank 7 or lower, the engine neither copies nor computes it.
- **Why it changed:** people reported quality loss, so it is off unless you turn it on.
- **What it changes in speed and in the text.** On 2 x RTX A4000 (IQ3_XXS) decode with it Off is 47.0 tok/s in the first chat on two cards (50.8 on 0.2.16, where it was On) and 35.5 on one card (39.2). On an RTX 5090 (UD-Q4_K_XL, DFlash2, 5 kinds of request, 2 rounds) the mean decode is 73.4 tok/s Off and 94.5 On (x1.29); the forced-token KL against exact routing is 0.0126 with it On. Because of the new default, the BASE-05 answers of a Radeon R9700 (gfx1201) and a Tesla P100 (sm_60) differ from 0.2.16's in 10 of 10 prompts at the defaults and are identical with `STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7`; on the RTX cards (sm_120) the two prompts that differ come from the `--short-read` default below, and are identical with `--short-read 64`.
- **Turn it on:** Expert settings, "Skip rarely used parts of the model" = On (rank 7); in the Terminal, `strata launch --set STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7`; or in the `"env"` of the model's run config. Ranks 1 to 9 stay available. A value you set yourself, even 0, is never changed.
- **Where Off comes from:** Control sets `STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0` for every start unless you set the variable, and setup writes it into every Unsloth config, so engine 0.1.62 and older also run with it off under this version. Engine 0.1.63 itself reads an unset value as off on every backend.
- **If you updated from 0.2.16:** you had "Automatic" or never touched it: it is now Off (the 0.2.16 "Automatic" was rank 7 on CUDA). If you had picked rank 7, or any other rank, that stays. A 0 stays Off. A PC with 64 GB in `--resident-budget-gib` mode used to run On with no entry and now runs Off.

## Setup uses more of your RAM

- **The rule, for the Unsloth files UD-Q4_K_XL and UD-IQ4_XS:** when their experts do not all fit in RAM, setup keeps `RAM - 17 - the streamed KV cache` GiB of them in RAM (0.2.16: `RAM - 24`). The other models (IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S, Q2_0) get no such budget, in 0.2.16 and 0.2.17 alike. A real 64 GiB limit, UD-Q4_K_XL, an RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell card:

| RAM budget | SSD read for a 65K prompt | decode | free RAM of 64 GiB | a later 8 GiB program |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40 (0.2.16) | 97.7 GB | 57.7 tok/s | 16.6 GiB | ran on |
| 47 (0.2.17) | 37.0 GB | 84.2 tok/s | 9.3 GiB | ran on |
| 52 | 0.9 GB | 83.4 to 88.6 tok/s | 6.6 GiB | killed |

- **Per PC size** (UD-Q4_K_XL): 32 GB 8 -> 15, 48 GB 24 -> 31, 64 GB 40 -> 47. From 96 GB of RAM every expert is in RAM, as before. A PC with one shared memory for CPU and GPU (Strix Halo and the like) and the two-card layer split stay at 24 left.
- **A "64 GB" Windows PC reads 6

[Engine] Turing (sm_75): make the STRATA_SM75_PERF series the default, with expert mode 8 for i-quant packs

[Engine] Layer-major prefill on a CUDA layer split: 32K prompts 2.0x faster, 0.47x drive reads (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, v0.2.4.2)

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.17-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.17-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.17-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata. All supporters and how to support Strata: [SUPPORTERS.md](SUPPORTERS.md) [MIT license](LICENSE) · [Credits and model licenses](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits) · [Privacy](docs/SAFETY.md) For AI tools and automated readers: technical reference · setup instructions. **Sponsorships, hardware partnerships or collaborations:** [niko.veit@outlook.com](mailto:niko.veit@outlook.com).
